code_state_note: Findings describe the code read at the start of this independent review. The parent is implementing follow-up changes concurrently; listed gaps and original line numbers are historical review findings, not a claim that they remain unresolved in the final code.
existing_strengths: Gold-document aliases and char-near queries are unioned before splitting; no shared canonical gold document crosses existing splits.
GroupKFold keeps existing query components intact; scaler and supervised model fit only on the training fold.
Missed positives are never injected into candidates; no-positive queries leave supervised fitting but remain in the full query evaluation cohort.
Group bootstrap samples complete components and uses their query counts for the query-macro estimand.

gaps_verified_at_review_start.gap: summarize currently computes only each learned model versus RRF, and only nDCG@10. No paired interval versus BM25 or for Recall@20.
One fixed random negative sample with cap50 is used; sampling-cap, hardness and seed robustness are not evaluated.
Equal total weight per query does not balance observed positive versus proxy-negative classes within a query; commonly one positive faces up to50 negatives.
CV summary pools held-out query scores but does not save per-fold fitted-query/positive/negative/weight counts needed to diagnose training support.

paired_intervals.resampling: same paired group draws for all methods; 2000 iterations; query-macro difference
paired_intervals.interpretation: exploratory post-selection development uncertainty, not a confirmatory significance claim

negative_sampling.control: Hold reviewed cohort, candidates, CV folds, feature set and hyperparameter grids fixed. Avoid a full Cartesian sweep initially; compare one factor at a time against the same cap50 baseline.

fold_audit: training queries with/without a recalled positive
sum of sample weights by class and query
minimum_prespecified_additions.test_policy: Freeze old holdout manifest SHA, preserve all old splits and quarantine every cross-old-split merged component. Never optimize sampling/group rules on test retrieval metrics.
minimum_prespecified_additions.comparison_policy: Report the new reviewed/quarantined cohort as a new experiment version; run head/full and backends on the same retained query IDs. Earlier development means are historical evidence, not directly comparable before/after scores.
